description: Agent-agnostic benchmark contracts for scientific visualization skills. Machine checks cover deliverable/provenance contracts; expert review covers scientific and visual quality.

anchors.5: Fully traceable to the provided evidence/source

cases.title: Final scientific figure QA
cases.task: Audit a completed scientific figure for truthful encoding, uncertainty/missing-data handling, accessibility, publication sizing and export readiness without changing the underlying evidence.

cases.title: Claim-to-data figure design
cases.task: Turn a scientific claim plus tabular evidence into an appropriate reproducible figure with defensible statistical semantics and a documented figure contract.

cases.title: Manuscript plus raw-data package
cases.task: From a manuscript excerpt and raw CSV/XLSX inputs, produce a publication-ready figure/table package with reproducible analysis and concise reporting.

cases.title: Semantic-preserving chart refinement
cases.task: Improve a semantically correct but visually weak Python chart while preserving values, scales, statistical meaning and category relationships.

cases.title: Editable research framework diagram
cases.task: Create an editable method/framework diagram from a structured research description. Preserve explicit uncertainty and do not invent unsupported components.

cases.title: Model topology recovery
cases.task: Recover the execution topology of supplied ML model code/config before producing a publication abstraction. Unknown internals must remain unknown rather than inferred for aesthetics.

cases.title: Reference diagram to editable PPTX
cases.task: Reconstruct a supplied scientific diagram as native editable PowerPoint shapes/text/connectors while preserving topology and labels.
